video_title: Jordi Fernández Postgame Press Conference vs. Memphis Grizzlies

quotes.speaker: Jordi Fernández
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordi Fernández on the team's inconsistency and turnover struggles
quotes.excerpt: 30 points of 16 turnovers is pretty impressive to their 14 for 15 points
quotes.quote: I think the inconsistency and you see it on the possession game with points off turnovers. Every loose ball was for them. They fought it, they won it, and 30 points of 16 turnovers is pretty impressive to their 14 for 15 points. Then you go to the free throws, you go to the second chance points, all that adds up and that's where you lose the game. I think we cut it to seven at some point and you should have been in the game, but we are not mature enough. We played against a team that played in the second of a back-to-back with the same travel that we had and they played the right way, played really hard, and we are not there yet.
quotes.social_post: Jordi Fernandez on the Nets loss to the Grizzlies: We are not mature enough. We played against a team that played in the second of a back to back and they played the right way and played really hard and we are not there yet.

structured.context: Jordi Fernandez discusses the team's loss to the Memphis Grizzlies and their struggles with turnovers and inconsistency.

quotes.speaker: Jordi Fernández
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordi Fernández on the team's failure to secure 50-50 balls
quotes.excerpt: a lot of those 50-50 balls, we didn't come up with those balls
quotes.quote: That team pressures the ball, but once again I thought that a lot of those 50-50 balls, we didn't come up with those balls and they made more winning plays than us. I can give you a lot of them that I have in my mind from throwing, like inbounding the ball to the other team three times to outlet passes to the other team. Like those are very loud mistakes. Can it happen one time? Yes, but when it happens like six times, those are big swings and we just got to believe that we are better and work and do it consistently.
quotes.social_post: Jordi Fernandez calls out the Nets for loud mistakes after the loss to Memphis: Inbounding the ball to the other team three times and outlet passes to the other team. Those are big swings and we just have to work and do it consistently.

structured.context: Jordi Fernandez explains the team's failure to secure loose balls and the impact of unforced errors during the game.

quotes.speaker: Jordi Fernández
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordi Fernández on the team's inability to translate practice to games
quotes.quote: I think you answered the question, it's frustrating. They play harder than us.
quotes.social_post: Jordi Fernandez on the Nets lack of effort against the Grizzlies: It is frustrating. They played harder than us.

structured.context: Jordi Fernandez reacts to a question regarding the team's lack of effort compared to their opponent.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jordi Fernández on Mike's absence for personal reasons

quotes.quote: We want to give him his privacy, everything it's fine, so we're happy that he was here.
quotes.social_post: Jordi Fernandez provided a brief update on Mike missing time for personal reasons: We want to give him his privacy, everything is fine, so we are happy that he was here.

quotes.speaker: Jordi Fernández
quotes.summary_phrase: Jordi Fernández on the development of young guards
quotes.excerpt: they got to grow fast that they're not being 20 is not an excuse
quotes.quote: They got to grow fast that they're not being 20 is not an excuse and I just think that they're me, I'm frustrated or I get mad because I know they're very good and they're better than this and when I just don't see a connected group is when it hurts because we made those pushes and cut it to 10, cut it to seven, so forth and it's just frustrating.
quotes.social_post: Jordi Fernandez says being young is no excuse for the Nets: They have to grow fast. Being 20 is not an excuse. I get mad because I know they are very good and they are better than this.

structured.context: Jordi Fernandez expresses frustration with the development and lack of connection among the team's young guards.
